items.question: Who becomes freed from all diseases and fit for union with yogis after six months of practice?
premises: six months of practice is prescribed
the practitioner wears ochre free from bondage
items.inference: sustained practice in the ochre robe leads to liberation from disease and yogic fellowship
uncertainties: exact voice and mood of abhyased
items.plain_english: Whoever practices for six months in the ochre robe, free from bondage, becomes freed from all diseases and joins in union with yogis.

items.question: What companionship results for one freed from all diseases through this practice?
premises: freedom from all diseases is attained
items.inference: the accomplished practitioner enters communal fellowship with yogis
uncertainties: whether melakam is accusative object or adverbial
items.plain_english: Freed from all diseases, he has union together with yogis.

items.question: What teaching about the soul's practice has now been given to the devotee?
premises: this practice of the soul is declared
items.inference: the preceding instruction on soul-practice is now completed for the recipient
uncertainties: whether kathitaṃ agrees with etat or jīvābhyāsaṃ
items.plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.

items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given according to this rule?
premises: the recipient is endowed with all states
the recipient has a resolved mind
items.inference: the teaching is restricted to a fully qualified and resolute recipient
uncertainties: whether dātavyaṃ is nominative or accusative
items.plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.

items.question: What kaula teaching must not be given even to yoginīs?
premises: the kaula essence is not to be given
it concerns the origin of yoginīs
items.inference: the core kaula essence remains withheld despite yoginī origin
uncertainties: whether sambhavam modifies sāraṃ or yoginīnām
items.plain_english: The kaula essence, the origin of yoginīs, is not to be given.

items.question: What condition of the body is lamented as struck by ignorance's veil?
premises: yet it is struck by ignorance's veil
items.inference: bodily purity coexists with obscuration by ignorance
uncertainties: whether nirmalaṃ agrees with deham or stands independently
items.plain_english: Today my pure body is struck by the veil of ignorance.
